name: Lalbaug Grand Walking Trail
tagline: 4 Iconic Pandals • 1.6 km Walk • ~35 mins walk
travelTip: Start at Chinchpokli station by 6:00 AM. Visit Chinchpoklicha Chintamani and Ganesh Galli first before the giant Lalbaugcha Raja queue peaks.

name: Girgaon Historical Heritage Trail
tagline: 3 Historic Pandals • 1.1 km Walk • ~25 mins walk
travelTip: Visit Mumbai's very first pandal (est. 1893 by Lokmanya Tilak) in Keshavji Naik Chawl, then stroll through the bustling chawl lanes to the 40-foot giant idol at Khetwadi 12th Lane.

name: Vedic & Golden Ganpati Tour
tagline: 2 Sacred Mandals • Pure Gold Idols • Free Annadanam Prasadam
travelTip: Plan your visit between 12:00 PM and 2:00 PM to receive sacred festive lunch prasadam (Annadanam) served on fresh banana leaves.
